Fresh 1 MiB/single-tab Windows processes; matched typing-only prefix, 50ms cadence. OS input is Win32 SendInput, not physical hardware or IME. Qt inputs bypass the Windows keyboard queue. Off still includes probe clocks, paint hooks, heartbeat and memory sampling. Every mode retains clock edges and derived counts of later posted inputs awaiting dispatch. These are observed injected-workload counts, not Windows/Qt internal queue length. Paint end is QWidget completion, not display presentation. Foreground/exposure checks are observations, not proof against sub-heartbeat focus changes. Incomplete/unknown foreground runs are excluded, with all raw failures and tails retained. Latest recovery drafts are acknowledged before memory sampling. Working set is not heap usage. Small-sample nearest-rank p99 can equal max. No causal performance improvement claim follows from an incomplete comparison.
